candidates.source_name: Centrálny register zmlúv (CRZ) – hlavný vyhľadávač zmlúv
candidates.why_relevant: Statutory central register run by Úrad vlády SR; SK law (546/2010 Z.z., Občiansky zákonník §47a) makes mandatorily-published contracts effective only the day after publication here, so essentially every signed contract of ministries, state agencies, public-law institutions and state-owned companies (Slovenská pošta, SZRB, Eximbanka) for POS/payment terminals, ATM servicing, core banking/IT and cash logistics lands here as a full PDF with vendor legal entity, price and often SLA annexes. Advanced search supports supplier name, IČO, contract subject, price range and date range, which is exactly the query surface needed for vendor/competitor and partnership mapping. Confirmed live: search returns e.g. ATM lease contracts with Slovenská sporiteľňa (Mesto Svätý Jur, /zmluva/10518371/) and ČSOB (Obec Rozhanovce, /zmluva/7782450/); counter showed ~5.83M published contracts.
candidates.legal_status: official government register, contracts are legally public information (zák. 211/2000 Z.z.)
candidates.suggested_collection_method: Scheduled keyword+IČO searches against the search form (query params such as art_predmet, art_zs2 supplier name, art_suma_spolu_od, art_rezort, ID=2171273) with polite rate limiting; harvest contract detail pages at /zmluva/{id}/ and download attached PDFs; complement with the site RSS feed for new publications. Prefer the open-data XML dumps for bulk backfill and the HTML search only for targeted queries.
candidates.discovered_via_method: seed query + direct fetch of the CRZ search page with a Slovak keyword parameter
queries_used: centrálny register zmlúv crz.gov.sk zmluva bankomat servis
crz.gov.sk zmluva platobný terminál POS dodávateľ

VAT, publication date, department, owner). Useful for onboarding non-Slovak analysts and for documenting the register's legal basis in English; also exposes the RSS feed path and the legacy zmluvy.gov.sk pointer.
candidates.suggested_collection_method: One-off documentation fetch; re-check annually for changes in scope/obliged entities.
candidates.discovered_via_method: fetched from CRZ site navigation while inspecting the register

Path advertised on the CRZ English page; content and item granularity not yet inspected.
candidates.suggested_collection_method: Poll daily, diff item GUIDs, then fetch matching /zmluva/{id}/ detail pages for keyword-matching contracts.

candidates.source_name: CRZ open-data dataset (data.gov.sk / data.slovensko.sk)
candidates.why_relevant: Official open-data distribution of CRZ change batches in XML (contract metadata plus links to the contract documents). This is the sanctioned bulk route for building a local mirror of contract metadata for banking/payments vendor analysis, avoiding heavy scraping of the HTML search. Note: the /es/dataset/crz URL 302-redirects to the new national portal data.slovensko.sk, so the dataset landing path must be re-resolved there.

candidates.suggested_collection_method: Resolve the dataset on data.slovensko.sk, pull the XML change-batch distributions on a schedule, load metadata into a local store, then fetch only the PDFs matching banking/payments keyword filters.

candidates.why_relevant: Legacy/parallel government listing of contracts of individual ministries and public institutions (referenced from the CRZ portal as the pre-2011 and complementary archive). Valuable for historical vendor incumbency: which supplier held the ATM-servicing or core-banking IT contract before the current one, including entity-level listings such as Slovenská pošta (index.php?ID=53296).
candidates.suggested_collection_method: Targeted crawl of entity pages (index.php?ID=...) for banking-relevant institutions; use mainly for backfill before 2011 and cross-checks, not for ongoing monitoring.

candidates.why_relevant: Košice publishes all contracts from EUR 0 (above the legal minimum), links each contract to its annexes/amendments and allows search inside individual order line items — unusually granular for unit-price extraction on terminals, ATMs and IT services. candidates.source_name: Uvostat – Register zmlúv mirror, detailed search and API
candidates.why_relevant: Independent mirror of CRZ (~5.75M contracts, harvested since 2014) with a far better query surface than the official site: cross-field detailed search (supplier, client, subject, number, status, amount, dates), Excel exports of a subject's full profile, and a documented API filterable by contract and by purchaser/vendor IČO. It also joins contracts to public-procurement records, which links a signed contract back to its tender — or shows there was none (direct award), exactly the signal this cell targets.

negative_findings.description: Slovak disclosure law exempts contracts concluded within Štátna pokladnica's remit that relate to financial and payment services, as well as contracts securing the provision of payment services, from mandatory publication.
negative_findings.result_summary: Searching in Slovak for Štátna pokladnica contract disclosure surfaced the exemption rather than a browsable treasury contract stream; the treasury's payment-gateway relationships appear only as product terms documents on pokladnica.sk, not as signed supplier contracts.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: Absence of a payments contract in CRZ cannot be read as absence of a relationship. Any vendor-share or win/loss inference built on CRZ must carry this exemption caveat, especially for the treasury and bank-side payment services that are the core of this sector.

negative_findings.description: No official, documented REST API for CRZ was found; the sanctioned machine route is XML change-batch dumps via the national open-data catalogue, and the community record shows the practical APIs are third-party (uvostat, paid, ~6 req/min).
negative_findings.result_summary: The Slovensko.Digital platform hosts a standing 'Centrálny register zmlúv API' request thread and a mirrors thread, both pointing to third-party solutions rather than an official endpoint.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: Collection design must budget for bulk XML ingestion plus targeted HTML fetching, or for a paid third-party API — not for a free official API. Rate limits shape how fast a backfill can run.

negative_findings.description: Known CRZ bulk distributions (SQL dump, CSV of documents, torrent) carry metadata and document URLs but not the PDF files themselves; the full document archive was described as roughly 1TB.
negative_findings.result_summary: Explicitly stated in the Slovensko.Digital mirror thread ('neobsahuje' the documents).
negative_findings.why_it_matters: Unit prices, SLAs and subcontractor lists live inside the PDFs, not the metadata. A two-stage pipeline is required: metadata bulk load, then selective PDF fetch on keyword/IČO matches, with OCR budget for scanned annexes.

negative_findings.description: The NBS contracts page returned its column headers but an empty data table to a plain HTML fetch on the run date.
negative_findings.result_summary: Fields Názov zmluvy / Zmluvný partner / IČO / Predmet zmluvy / Dátum uzavretia / Dátum zverejnenia were present; no rows rendered.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: This is a hypothesis about client-side rendering, not evidence the register is empty. Collection needs a JS-capable fetcher or the underlying JSON endpoint; do not record NBS as a dead source.

negative_findings.description: The otvorenezmluvy.sk application itself never surfaced in results; only the Transparency International Slovensko announcement page describing it was reachable.
negative_findings.result_summary: Slovak-language query naming the portal returned the TIS article and unrelated registers.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: The NGO overlay may be dormant. Its eleven-criterion risk scoring is worth replicating in-house regardless, but it should not be listed as an active feed until liveness is verified by the deterministic pass.

negative_findings.description: The data.gov.sk CRZ dataset URL 302-redirected to the root of the new portal data.slovensko.sk, so the dataset's current landing page and distribution URLs were not confirmed in this pass.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: A migration is under way; the dataset almost certainly still exists under a new path. Recorded as moved/unverified rather than dead, and the exact distribution URLs must be re-resolved before building the ingestion job.

negative_findings.description: The Slovak term 'bankomat' in contract registers is dominated by real-estate leases of the few square metres an ATM stands on, signed by banks with municipalities.
negative_findings.result_summary: The first CRZ hits for 'bankomat' were an ATM-space lease from Slovenská sporiteľňa with Mesto Svätý Jur and a non-residential lease with ČSOB from Obec Rozhanovce — placement, not servicing.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: Naive keyword collection will fill the corpus with siting leases and miss the servicing/CIT/hardware contracts. Query design must combine 'bankomat' with servis/údržba/prevádzka/dopĺňanie hotovosti, or filter by supplier IČO of known vendors instead. Note the leases are still useful for ATM-footprint mapping — just a different signal.

negative_findings.description: Several high-value local terms in this cell's glossary were not yet run as searches in this pass: 'spracovanie hotovosti', 'prevoz cenín', 'peňažné prostriedky', 'dopĺňanie bankomatov', 'akceptácia platobných kariet', 'core banking systém', 'bankový informačný systém', 'samoobslužná zóna', 'recyklačný bankomat', 'platobná brána'.
negative_findings.result_summary: Coverage so far concentrated on register discovery rather than exhaustive term sweeps.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: Source discovery is adequate, but term coverage inside those sources is not. Without these terms the cash-logistics and core-banking sub-topics are under-sampled relative to POS/ATM.

negative_findings.description: Apart from the CRZ English UI shell, no English-language source specific to Slovak public contract registers for banking/payments was found; English queries returned generic or non-Slovak results.
negative_findings.result_summary: The English seed query surfaced the CRZ English portal and Wikipedia entries on NBS, nothing substantive.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: Confirms that all substantive collection in this cell must be Slovak-language, and that contract subject matching, glossary work and any classifier must operate in Slovak including diacritic-insensitive variants.

coverage_gaps.description: Only Bratislava region/city and Košice were sampled from the sub-national layer; the other seven VÚC (Trnavský, Trenčiansky, Nitriansky, Žilinský, Banskobystrický, Prešovský, Košický) and the larger regional cities have their own registers or platform deployments that were not enumerated.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Enumerate all eight VÚC and the top ~20 cities, record for each whether it publishes via CRZ, eGovZmluvy, a DATALAN/AGLO portal or its own system, and store the per-entity crawl URL.

coverage_gaps.description: State-linked buyers highly relevant to payments were not yet resolved to their CRZ entity pages: Slovenská pošta's subsidiaries, DataCentrum (MF SR IT), Sociálna poisťovňa, Finančná správa SR (eKasa / cash-register infrastructure), Železničná spoločnosť Slovensko and municipal transport companies (ticketing terminals, card acceptance).
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Resolve each buyer's CRZ entity page and add it as a per-entity crawl target; Finančná správa's eKasa estate in particular is a large adjacent terminal population.

coverage_gaps.description: All discovery so far is buyer-side. The complementary vendor-side sweep — searching CRZ by the IČO of known payment/ATM/banking-IT suppliers active in SK — has not been run, and no vendor IČO list exists for this cell yet.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Build a seed list of vendor legal entities (terminal and ATM vendors, CIT operators, core-banking and integration houses active in SK) with IČOs from ORSR/FinStat, then run supplier-IČO queries across CRZ, uvostat and the municipal platforms. This is the highest-yield next step for competitor mapping.

coverage_gaps.description: No assessment yet of what proportion of banking/payments contracts are attached as scanned images rather than text PDFs, which determines whether unit prices and SLAs can be extracted without OCR.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Sample 30-50 relevant contract PDFs across CRZ and the municipal platforms, measure the scanned share, and size an OCR step accordingly.

coverage_gaps.description: The link from a published contract back to its originating tender (or to the absence of one, i.e. a direct award) was identified as available via uvostat but not tested; the UVO/ÚVO procurement side belongs to a neighbouring cell and the join key was not established.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Test the contract-to-procurement join on a handful of known cases and document the join key (contract number, IČO pair, or UVO reference) so the two cells' outputs can be merged.

coverage_gaps.description: Dodatky (annexes) that change price, scope or extend term are the most commercially informative documents, but only Košice's portal was observed to explicitly link a contract to its amendment chain; how to reconstruct these chains in CRZ was not determined.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Determine whether CRZ metadata carries a parent-contract reference for dodatky, or whether chains must be rebuilt heuristically from contract numbers and party pairs; document the chosen method.

coverage_gaps.description: Diacritic-insensitive and inflected search behaviour of the CRZ search form was not tested (e.g. 'platobny' vs 'platobný', 'bankomatov' vs 'bankomat', 'terminálov'), nor whether it matches inside the contract text or only in metadata fields.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Run controlled probes on the search form with diacritic and case variants and with a term known to appear only in the document body, then codify the query expansion rules.

brief: Slovakia's contract-transparency layer is unusually rich for this cell: because a mandatorily-published contract only becomes effective on publication, the Centrálny register zmlúv (crz.gov.sk, ~5.8M contracts, run by Úrad vlády SR) holds full signed PDFs — vendor legal entities, prices, annexes — for ministries, state agencies and state-owned companies including Slovenská pošta, SZRB and Eximbanka, and it is searchable by supplier, IČO, subject and price band. A second, institution-level tier sits beside it: NBS publishes its own contract/order/invoice register outside CRZ, while VÚC and cities publish via their own portals or platforms such as eGovZmluvy, zverejnovanie.bratislava.sk and Košice's line-item-searchable system, and third parties (uvostat with a paid API, FinStat, TIS) provide better query surfaces and entity resolution over the same corpus. The main constraints are structural rather than access-related: there is no official REST API (bulk XML dumps plus selective PDF fetching instead), bulk dumps exclude the documents where prices and SLAs live, Štátna pokladnica's financial and payment-services contracts are statutorily exempt from publication, and the term 'bankomat' is dominated by ATM-siting leases rather than servicing contracts. Next priority is a vendor-side sweep by supplier IČO plus enumeration of the remaining VÚC, cities and payments-relevant state buyers such as Finančná správa.
